svg.title: Figure 1 · How folder documentation is produced and enforced
svg.desc: One catalog and the SysML models drive every generated README, figure and SysML view; hand-authored folders keep a figures.yaml. CI rebuilds everything and fails on any difference or missing section.
svg.text: Figure 1 · How folder documentation is produced and enforced
One catalog and the SysML models drive every generated README, figure and SysML view; hand-authored
folders keep a figures.yaml. CI rebuilds everything and fails on any difference or missing section.

g.text: Terms: CI = continuous integration (the automated checks GitHub runs on every change) · DoD = US Department of Defense · ELK = Eclipse Layout Kernel, the
engine that lays out the generated figures · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · PR = pull request (a
proposed change on GitHub) · SVG = Scalable Vector Graphics, the figure file format · SysML = Systems Modeling Language (SysML v2) · US = United States
